title: Mall Bats: A nostalgic tycoon-inspired game in the ceiling
author: jacobjr23
selftext:
This is a game I was inspired to make after watching the fun documentary "Secret Mall Apartment" last year. After my first attempt, I quickly realized AI was not there yet, and I definitely don't have the talent or perseverance for game design otherwise.

I recently gave it another shot, and I'm very happy with the result. It's open source at [https://github.com/jacobgoldfarb/mall-bat](https://github.com/jacobgoldfarb/mall-bat), and 100% free to play or copy (GPL 3.0) -- please enjoy, give feedback, and feel free to contribute to make it even better!
